verdicts.reason: A keeps the can large and clear and puts the logo at the top. But the attribution 'THE SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' is set bolder and almost as large as the quote and sits jammed under it, 'soon.' is orphaned on its own line, the logo is tiny, and the brown circle has come loose from the can and floats empty at the bottom. B shrinks the can into an unreadable orange speck inside the circle, and the SOLSTICE logo is essentially gone. It also has the same oversized, cramped attribution and leaves a large dead area at the top, so the key product image and the brand are lost.
